data.briefDescription: Learn the basics of backpacking. Get ready to head into the backcountry and discover new places. Whether you are a seasoned hiker who wants to extend your hike across multiple days, or if you are new to the outdoors, this presentation will give you the essential information you need.
data.longDescription:
Curious about what’s waiting beyond the next mile? Turn that curiosity into confidence on the trail. Whether you’re planning your first overnight or looking to go further, this class covers the essentials to help you prepare, pack, and head into the backcountry with purpose. 

Learn how to choose the right gear, plan a safe and responsible trip, and pack efficiently so you’re ready for whatever the trail has in store. Along the way, you’ll gain the skills to make informed decisions and minimize your impact—so you can spend less time second-guessing and more time exploring what’s out there.
data.name: Backpacking Basics

data.briefDescription: Find your way outside by learning practical map and compass navigation skills. This workshop will teach you how to read key features on topographic maps, identify the parts of a compass, how to find north, follow bearings, and plan a route for your next outdoor adventure.
data.longDescription: Find your way outside by learning practical map and compass navigation skills. This workshop will teach you how to read key features on topographic maps, identify the parts of a compass, how to find north, follow bearings, and plan a route for your next outdoor adventure. Through facilitated discussion and a series of easygoing activities, you will walk away with new knowledge that will help you push your boundaries and prevent you from getting lost!

data.briefDescription: Flat tires can impact every rider on every surface. If you want to be ready to fix your next flat, join an REI bike mechanic for this hands hands-on workshop. Bike wheels will be available or bring your own.
data.longDescription: Flat tires happen—on trails, roads, and everywhere in between. If you want to be ready when they do, join an REI bike expert for this hands-on workshop designed to build your confidence and skills. From start to finish, you’ll learn how to change a tire, troubleshoot common issues, and reduce the chances of a repeat flat. We’ll provide bike wheels for practice, or feel free to bring your own. Please wear clothes you don’t mind getting a little greasy and closed-toe shoes. Whether you're new to cycling or just want a refresher, this session will get you rolling again in no time.
data.name: Flat Tire Repair Workshop

data.briefDescription: A well-tuned bike can help make riding smooth and efficient. Join an REI bike mechanic for a workshop on how to care for and maintain your bike's derailleurs and chain. Bring your own bike or practice on one of ours.
data.longDescription: A well-tuned bike can help make riding smooth and efficient. Grinding gears, rubbing derailleurs, and squeaky chains are your bike's cry for help. Ready to learn how to prevent or eliminate these annoyances from your beloved bike? Join an REI bike mechanic for a workshop on how to care for and maintain your bike's derailleurs and chain. We will tune derailleurs, adjust shifting, and diagnose common chain issues. Along the way, you will learn best practices for care and cleaning with plenty of get-your-hands-dirty chances to practice. Bring your own bike or practice on one of ours. Participants should wear closed-toed shoes and dress in clothing that can get dirty or greasy.
data.name: Bike Chains and Derailleurs Workshop

results.name: American Pilgrims Present: Exploring El Camino de Santiago

data.briefDescription: Come learn about the preparation involved that will allow you to hike the Camino de Santiago, a trail system in France, Spain, Portugal, etc.!
data.longDescription:
El Camino de Santiago, or “The Way of Saint James,” is a network of ancient pilgrimage routes leading to the cathedral in Santiago de Compostela in northwestern Spain, believed to be the resting place of Saint James. Pilgrims have walked these paths for centuries, seeking spiritual growth, cultural immersion, and personal transformation. Today, the Camino welcomes travelers from around the world who come for a variety of reasons—from adventure and reflection to connection and renewal.

Join American Pilgrims on the Camino for an inspiring session that brings to life the incredible tradition and epic adventure of the Camino de Santiago. Through personal stories, cultural insights, and practical advice, you'll gain a deeper understanding of both the spirit and logistics of pilgrimage. Whether you're just beginning to explore the idea or actively preparing for your own journey, this session offers meaningful guidance and a chance to connect with a welcoming community of fellow travelers. Each presentation reflects the unique perspective of its speaker, and topics may vary by REI location—please see the Notes section below for details.
data.name: American Pilgrims Present: Exploring El Camino de Santiago

data.briefDescription: Looking to reinvigorate your runs brand new running and don't know where to start? Join us to learn about the world of road running, the gear you need, how to train for that next race, and more!
data.longDescription:
Step out your door and discover what’s possible—one step at a time! Road running is one of the most accessible ways to stay active, clear your mind, and explore your surroundings. Whether you’re brand new or getting back into a routine, this class helps turn your first steps into lasting confidence. 

You’ll learn the fundamentals—from choosing the right footwear and gear to building a safe, sustainable running plan—so you can move more comfortably, avoid common setbacks, and keep building momentum.
data.name: Road Running Basics

data.briefDescription: Trail running can be a great change of pace from the jog around the neighborhood. Learn about technique, training, clothing and footwear specific to the sport of trail running.
data.longDescription:
Looking to take your run beyond the pavement? Trade steady surfaces for winding paths, changing terrain, and the rhythm of moving through nature. Trail running invites you to explore landscapes in a way that feels both energizing and grounding. Whether you’re new to running or ready to change things up, this class helps you build the skills to move confidently through it all. 

You’ll explore footwear, essential gear, hydration and fueling, and key safety considerations—so you can navigate uneven terrain, adapt to changing conditions, and fully enjoy the experience of running on the path less traveled.
data.name: Trail Running Basics

data.briefDescription: Go hiking with confidence and experience the outdoors in new ways! Whether you're preparing to go out for the first time or looking to update your hiking gear, this presentation is for anyone who enjoys time on the trail.
data.longDescription:
Step beyond the everyday—and head out onto the trail. Hiking is one of the simplest and most rewarding ways to stay active, explore new places, and build confidence outdoors. Whether you’re planning your first hike or looking to go farther, this class covers the essentials to help you prepare, pack, and move through the outdoors with purpose. 

You’ll learn how to choose the right gear, plan a safe and responsible trip, and pack efficiently—so you can spend less time second-guessing and more time enjoying the fresh air, changing landscapes, and the freedom to go further.
data.name: Hiking Basics

data.longDescription:
Ready to discover the birds all around you? Join the Travis Audubon Society for a four-part in-person classroom series designed for anyone interested in learning the fundamentals of birding. Whether you're completely new to birdwatching or looking to build your identification skills, this course will provide the tools and knowledge to help you get started.

Over four engaging sessions, participants will learn how to identify birds by sight and sound, use field guides and binoculars, understand bird migration and conservation, and become familiar with many of the bird species found in Central Texas. No prior birding experience is necessary. This welcoming and informative series is a great way to build confidence, connect with fellow nature enthusiasts, and start a lifelong appreciation for birds and the natural world!

Note: Members of the Travis Audubon Society are eligible for discounted member pricing.

We’ll walk through what to consider before your trip, how to stay comfortable sleeping outside, and how to set up a simple, functional camp kitchen. You’ll leave with the know-how to feel ready and excited for your next night under the stars.
